title: Zod Schema Validation
description: Zod 4 reference covering parsing, inferred types, object policies, unions, refinements, transforms, async validation, recursive schemas, errors, JSON Schema, performance, and API-boundary design.

subtopics.title: parse, safeParse & Inference
subtopics.description: Parsing validates unknown input and returns typed output. parse throws; safeParse returns a discriminated result; async checks require async parsing.

table.title: Parse API Selection
rows: Trusted internal boundary with exception mapping

subtopics.title: Primitives, Objects & Unknown Keys
subtopics.description: Build schemas from the smallest constraints and choose an explicit unknown-key policy at trust boundaries.

callouts.title: Coercion Accepts Broad Input
callouts.text: Constrain or preprocess inputs intentionally; JavaScript coercion may accept values your domain did not mean to allow.

subtopics.title: Unions & Discriminated Unions
subtopics.description: Use discriminated unions for tagged variants: they improve runtime selection, error locality, and TypeScript narrowing.

subtopics.title: Refinements, Checks & Transforms
subtopics.description: Use built-in checks first, refine for one predicate, superRefine for multiple targeted issues, and transform only when parsing should change output.

callouts.title: Validation Should Be Deterministic
callouts.text: Keep network/database uniqueness checks in an async application boundary and account for races with authoritative database constraints.

subtopics.title: Recursive, Branded & Collection Schemas
subtopics.description: Use lazy getters for recursive data, brands for validated nominal distinctions, and record/map/set schemas when JSON objects are not the right model.

subtopics.title: Error Trees & API Mapping
subtopics.description: Map Zod issues into stable application error codes and field paths; do not expose internal diagnostics or echo secrets.

callouts.title: Keep Transport Errors Stable
callouts.text: ZodError is a library detail. Translate it at API/UI boundaries so clients are not coupled to issue formatting across upgrades.

subtopics.title: Input, Domain & Output Schemas
subtopics.description: Separate permissive input normalization from strict domain values and public output contracts. Reusing one schema everywhere can accidentally expose fields.

codeBlocks.code:
const CreateUserInput = z.object({ email: z.string().trim().toLowerCase().pipe(z.email()) });
const PublicUser = User.pick({ id: true, email: true, displayName: true });

subtopics.title: Performance & Review Checklist
subtopics.description: Parse once at trust boundaries, reuse schema instances, benchmark huge unions/objects, cap payload depth/size, and test both accepted and rejected cases.

callouts.title: Production Checklist
callouts.text: Start from unknown, choose strictness, distinguish input/output types, use async parsing when required, map errors, avoid secret echo, version public contracts, and test schema migrations.
